seniority_band: Head — owns the partnerships function and carries its number. Sets partner strategy, hires and directs a small team, and is accountable to the exec staff for sourced pipeline. Not an IC who manages an inherited account list.
must_haves: Owned a partner portfolio with a number attached to it — sourced or influenced pipeline, co-sell revenue, or marketplace GMV. The number has to appear in their own account of the work, not be inferable from the job title.

Closed and then operated partnerships with AI or cloud platform vendors — model providers, hyperscaler marketplaces, or ISVs building on top of a platform. Signing is not the job; the year after signing is the job.
Built or rebuilt a partner motion rather than inheriting one — first partner program, first marketplace listing, first co-sell agreement, or a documented turnaround of a stalled one.
Technical fluency sufficient to scope an integration with an engineering team: can describe what was actually built with a partner, in what order, and what broke.
nice_to_haves: Ran an AWS / Azure / GCP marketplace listing end to end, including private offers
Public ecosystem presence — conference talks, partner-facing docs, developer relations crossover
Took a partner org from seed/Series A into scale, or the reverse move from big-platform BD into a startup
Prior founder, or a BD-engineering hybrid background
disqualifiers: Channel resale only — reseller/distributor management with no technical integration work
Requires visa sponsorship and this req cannot sponsor
IC-only track with no portfolio, budget, or team ownership at any point
